     3→ *
     4→ * Scala translation using idiomatic patterns:

     6→ *  - Type classes for structural typing (replacing Python Protocols)
     7→ *  - Option/Either for error handling instead of None/exceptions
     8→ *  - Immutable collections by default
     9→ *  - Higher-kinded types where Python could only simulate them
    10→ *  - Pattern matching for type dispatch
    11→ */

    13→import java.time.{LocalDate, LocalDateTime}

    18→

    20→// Enums and Constants
    21→// ============================================================================
    22→
    23→sealed trait TokenType {
    24→  def value: String
    25→}
    26→
    27→object TokenType {
    28→  case object String extends TokenType { val value = "string" }
    29→  case object Numeric extends TokenType { val value = "numeric" }
    30→  case object Temporal extends TokenType { val value = "temporal" }
    31→  case object Structured extends TokenType { val value = "structured" }
    32→  case object Binary extends TokenType { val value = "binary" }

    48→  implicit val intTokenizable: Tokenizable[Int] = (a: Int) => a.toString
    49→  implicit val doubleTokenizable: Tokenizable[Double] = (a: Double) => a.toString
    50→  implicit val bigDecimalTokenizable: Tokenizable[BigDecimal] = (a: BigDecimal) => a.toString
    51→}

    53→trait HasLength[A] {

    55→}

    65→final case class Token(

    68→    metadata: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty

    74→class MutableTokenBatch {

    95→class TokenContainer[+A](items: Seq[A]) {

    98→  def getAll: Vector[A] = _items
    99→

   104→class TokenSink[-A] {
   105→  private val _received: mutable.ListBuffer[Any] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty

   118→class BivariantHandler[A](default: A) {

   133→// ============================================================================
   134→// Tokenizer Implementations

   137→trait BaseTokenizer[A] {

   144→class StringTokenizer(
   145→    encoding: String = "UTF-8",
   146→    normalizer: String => String = identity

   148→
   149→  override def tokenize(value: Either[String, Array[Byte]]): Token = {
   150→    val strValue = value match {
   151→      case Left(s)      => s
   152→      case Right(bytes) => new String(bytes, encoding)
   153→    }
   154→    val normalized = normalizer(strValue)
   155→    Token(normalized, TokenType.String)
   156→  }
   157→}
   158→
   159→class NumericTokenizer(
   160→    precision: Int = 6,
   161→    formatOptions: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
   162→) extends BaseTokenizer[Either[Int, Either[Double, BigDecimal]]] {
   163→
   164→  override def tokenize(value: Either[Int, Either[Double, BigDecimal]]): Token = {
   165→    val (strValue, originalType) = value match {
   166→      case Left(i) =>
   167→        (i.toString, "Int")
   168→      case Right(Left(d)) =>
   169→        (s"%.${precision}f".format(d), "Double")
   170→      case Right(Right(bd)) =>
   171→        (bd.setScale(precision, BigDecimal.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).toPlainString, "BigDecimal")
   172→    }
   173→    Token(strValue, TokenType.Numeric, Map("original_type" -> originalType))
   174→  }
   175→}

   177→class TemporalTokenizer(
   178→    formatStr: Option[String] = None
   179→) extends BaseTokenizer[Either[LocalDateTime, LocalDate]] {
   180→
   181→  private val IsoFormat: DateTimeFormatter =
   182→    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")
   183→  private val DateFormat: DateTimeFormatter =
   184→    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd")
   185→
   186→  override def tokenize(value: Either[LocalDateTime, LocalDate]): Token = {
   187→    val formatted = (formatStr, value) match {
   188→      case (Some(fmt), Left(dt))  => dt.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(fmt))
   189→      case (Some(fmt), Right(d))  => d.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(fmt))
   190→      case (None, Left(dt))       => dt.format(IsoFormat)
   191→      case (None, Right(d))       => d.format(DateFormat)
   192→    }
   193→    Token(formatted, TokenType.Temporal)
   194→  }
   195→}
   196→
   197→// ============================================================================
   198→// Advanced: Union Types via ADT + Pattern Matching
   199→// ============================================================================
   200→
   201→sealed trait TokenizableValue
   202→object TokenizableValue {
   203→  case class StringValue(value: String) extends TokenizableValue
   204→  case class BytesValue(value: Array[Byte]) extends TokenizableValue
   205→  case class IntValue(value: Int) extends TokenizableValue
   206→  case class DoubleValue(value: Double) extends TokenizableValue
   207→  case class DecimalValue(value: BigDecimal) extends TokenizableValue
   208→  case class DateTimeValue(value: LocalDateTime) extends TokenizableValue
   209→  case class DateValue(value: LocalDate) extends TokenizableValue
   210→  case class CustomTokenizable(toToken: String) extends TokenizableValue
   211→  case object NullValue extends TokenizableValue
   212→  case class FallbackValue(value: Any) extends TokenizableValue
   213→}
   214→
   215→class UniversalTokenizer {
   216→  private val stringTokenizer = new StringTokenizer()
   217→  private val numericTokenizer = new NumericTokenizer()
   218→  private val temporalTokenizer = new TemporalTokenizer()
   219→
   220→  def tokenize(value: TokenizableValue): Token = value match {
   221→    case TokenizableValue.NullValue =>
   222→      Token("NULL", TokenType.Null)
   223→
   224→    case TokenizableValue.CustomTokenizable(tok) =>
   225→      Token(tok, TokenType.Structured)
   226→
   227→    case TokenizableValue.StringValue(s) =>
   228→      stringTokenizer.tokenize(Left(s))
   229→
   230→    case TokenizableValue.BytesValue(b) =>
   231→      stringTokenizer.tokenize(Right(b))
   232→
   233→    case TokenizableValue.IntValue(i) =>
   234→      numericTokenizer.tokenize(Left(i))
   235→
   236→    case TokenizableValue.DoubleValue(d) =>
   237→      numericTokenizer.tokenize(Right(Left(d)))
   238→
   239→    case TokenizableValue.DecimalValue(bd) =>
   240→      numericTokenizer.tokenize(Right(Right(bd)))
   241→
   242→    case TokenizableValue.DateTimeValue(dt) =>
   243→      temporalTokenizer.tokenize(Left(dt))
   244→
   245→    case TokenizableValue.DateValue(d) =>
   246→      temporalTokenizer.tokenize(Right(d))
   247→
   248→    case TokenizableValue.FallbackValue(v) =>
   249→      Token(v.toString, TokenType.String, Map("fallback" -> true))
   250→  }
   251→}
   252→
   253→// ============================================================================
   254→// Complex Nested Generics
   255→// ============================================================================
   256→
   257→class TokenRegistry[A] {
   258→  private val _registry: mutable.Map[String, TokenContainer[A]] = mutable.Map.empty
   259→  private val _handlers: mutable.ListBuffer[A => Option[Token]] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   260→
   261→  def register(key: String, container: TokenContainer[A]): Unit = {
   262→    _registry(key) = container
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  def addHandler(handler: A => Option[Token]): Unit = {
   266→    _handlers += handler
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  def process(key: String): List[Option[Token]] = {
   270→    _registry.get(key) match {
   271→      case None => List.empty
   272→      case Some(container) =>
   273→        container.getAll.map { item =>
   274→          _handlers.iterator
   275→            .map(handler => handler(item))
   276→            .collectFirst { case Some(token) => token }
   277→        }.toList
   278→    }
   279→  }
   280→}

   282→// ============================================================================
   283→// Higher-Kinded Types (proper Scala implementation)
   284→// ============================================================================
   285→
   286→class TokenFunctor[A](protected val _value: A) {
   287→  def map[B](func: A => B): TokenFunctor[B] =
   288→    new TokenFunctor(func(_value))
   289→
   290→  def flatMap[B](func: A => TokenFunctor[B]): TokenFunctor[B] =
   291→    func(_value)
   292→
   293→  def getOrElse[B >: A](default: => B): B =
   294→    if (_value != null) _value else default
   295→}
   296→
   297→class TokenMonad[A](value: A) extends TokenFunctor[A](value) {
   298→  def ap[B](funcWrapped: TokenMonad[A => B]): TokenMonad[B] =
   299→    new TokenMonad(funcWrapped._value(_value))

   301→
   302→object TokenMonad {
   303→  def pure[A](value: A): TokenMonad[A] = new TokenMonad(value)

   306→// ============================================================================
   307→// JSON Structure Tokenization
   308→// ============================================================================
   309→
   310→sealed trait JsonValue
   311→object JsonValue {
   312→  case class JsonString(value: String) extends JsonValue
   313→  case class JsonInt(value: Int) extends JsonValue
   314→  case class JsonDouble(value: Double) extends JsonValue
   315→  case class JsonBoolean(value: Boolean) extends JsonValue
   316→  case object JsonNull extends JsonValue
   317→  case class JsonArray(elements: List[JsonValue]) extends JsonValue
   318→  case class JsonObject(fields: Map[String, JsonValue]) extends JsonValue
   319→
   320→  /** Serialize a JsonValue to a JSON string. */
   321→  def toJsonString(value: JsonValue, pretty: Boolean = false, indent: Int = 0): String = {
   322→    val indentStr = if (pretty) "  " * indent else ""
   323→    val nextIndent = indent + 1
   324→
   325→    value match {
   326→      case JsonString(s) =>
   327→        "\"" + escapeJson(s) + "\""
   328→      case JsonInt(i) =>
   329→        i.toString
   330→      case JsonDouble(d) =>
   331→        d.toString
   332→      case JsonBoolean(b) =>
   333→        b.toString
   334→      case JsonNull =>
   335→        "null"
   336→      case JsonArray(elements) if elements.isEmpty =>
   337→        "[]"
   338→      case JsonArray(elements) =>
   339→        if (pretty) {
   340→          val inner = elements.map { e =>
   341→            "  " * nextIndent + toJsonString(e, pretty, nextIndent)
   342→          }
   343→          "[\n" + inner.mkString(",\n") + "\n" + indentStr + "]"
   344→        } else {
   345→          "[" + elements.map(e => toJsonString(e, pretty = false)).mkString(",") + "]"
   346→        }
   347→      case JsonObject(fields) if fields.isEmpty =>
   348→        "{}"
   349→      case JsonObject(fields) =>
   350→        if (pretty) {
   351→          val inner = fields.map { case (k, v) =>
   352→            "  " * nextIndent + "\"" + escapeJson(k) + "\": " +
   353→              toJsonString(v, pretty, nextIndent)
   354→          }
   355→          "{\n" + inner.mkString(",\n") + "\n" + indentStr + "}"
   356→        } else {
   357→          "{" + fields.map { case (k, v) =>
   358→            "\"" + escapeJson(k) + "\":" + toJsonString(v, pretty = false)
   359→          }.mkString(",") + "}"
   360→        }
   361→    }
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  private def escapeJson(s: String): String =
   365→    s.flatMap {
   366→      case '"'  => "\\\""
   367→      case '\\' => "\\\\"
   368→      case '\b' => "\\b"
   369→      case '\f' => "\\f"
   370→      case '\n' => "\\n"
   371→      case '\r' => "\\r"
   372→      case '\t' => "\\t"
   373→      case c if c < ' ' => "\\u%04x".format(c.toInt)
   374→      case c    => c.toString
   375→    }
   376→}
   377→
   378→class JsonTokenizer(pretty: Boolean = false) {
   379→
   380→  def tokenize(value: JsonValue): Token = {
   381→    val jsonStr = JsonValue.toJsonString(value, pretty)
   382→    Token(jsonStr, TokenType.Structured, Map("json" -> true))
   383→  }
   384→
   385→  def tokenizePath(value: JsonValue, path: String): Option[Token] = {
   386→    val parts = path.split("\\.")
   387→
   388→    val result = parts.foldLeft(Option(value): Option[JsonValue]) {
   389→      case (Some(JsonValue.JsonObject(fields)), part) =>
   390→        fields.get(part)
   391→      case (Some(JsonValue.JsonArray(elements)), part) if part.forall(_.isDigit) =>
   392→        val idx = part.toInt
   393→        if (idx >= 0 && idx < elements.size) Some(elements(idx))
   394→        else None
   395→      case _ =>
   396→        None
   397→    }
   398→
   399→    result.map(tokenize)
   400→  }
   401→}
   402→
   403→// ============================================================================
   404→// Whitespace Tokenizer - Basic Text Tokenization
   405→// ============================================================================
   406→
   407→class WhitespaceTokenizer(
   408→    lowercase: Boolean = false,
   409→    minLength: Int = 0,
   410→    maxLength: Option[Int] = None,
   411→    stripPunctuation: Boolean = false
   412→) {
   413→
   414→  private val punctuation: Set[Char] =
   415→    ".,!?;:'\"()[]{}".toSet
   416→
   417→  private def processToken(word: String): Option[String] = {
   418→    var w = word
   419→
   420→    if (stripPunctuation)
   421→      w = w.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse
   422→
   423→    if (lowercase)
   424→      w = w.toLowerCase
   425→
   426→    if (w.length < minLength)
   427→      return None
   428→
   429→    maxLength.foreach { max =>
   430→      if (w.length > max)
   431→        w = w.take(max)
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    if (w.isEmpty) None else Some(w)
   435→  }
   436→
   437→  def tokenize(text: String): List[Token] = {
   438→    val words = text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)
   439→    words.zipWithIndex.flatMap { case (word, i) =>
   440→      processToken(word).map { processed =>
   441→        Token(
   442→          value = processed,
   443→          tokenType = TokenType.String,
   444→          metadata = Map("position" -> i, "original" -> word)
   445→        )
   446→      }
   447→    }.toList
   448→  }
   449→
   450→  def tokenizeToStrings(text: String): List[String] =
   451→    tokenize(text).map(_.value)
   452→
   453→  def tokenizeWithPositions(text: String): List[(String, Int, Int)] = {
   454→    val result = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[(String, Int, Int)]
   455→    var currentPos = 0
   456→
   457→    for (word <- text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)) {
   458→      val start = text.indexOf(word, currentPos)
   459→      val end = start + word.length
   460→
   461→      processToken(word).foreach { processed =>
   462→        result += ((processed, start, end))
   463→      }
   464→
   465→      currentPos = end
   466→    }
   467→
   468→    result.toList
   469→  }
   470→
   471→  def countTokens(text: String): Int =
   472→    tokenize(text).size
   473→}
   474→
   475→// ============================================================================
   476→// Builder Pattern with Fluent Interface
   477→// ============================================================================
   478→
   479→class TokenizerBuilder[A] {
   480→  private val _normalizers: mutable.ListBuffer[String => String] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   481→  private val _validators: mutable.ListBuffer[A => Boolean] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   482→  private var _metadata: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
   483→
   484→  def withNormalizer(normalizer: String => String): TokenizerBuilder[A] = {
   485→    _normalizers += normalizer
   486→    this
   487→  }
   488→
   489→  def withValidator(validator: A => Boolean): TokenizerBuilder[A] = {
   490→    _validators += validator
   491→    this
   492→  }
   493→
   494→  def withMetadata(entries: (String, Any)*): TokenizerBuilder[A] = {
   495→    _metadata = _metadata ++ entries.toMap
   496→    this
   497→  }
   498→
   499→  def build(): A => Token = {
   500→    val normalizers = _normalizers.toList
   501→    val validators = _validators.toList
   502→    val metadata = _metadata
   503→
   504→    (value: A) => {
   505→      validators.foreach { validator =>
   506→        if (!validator(value))
   507→          throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Validation failed for $value")
   508→      }
   509→
   510→      var strValue = value.toString
   511→      for (normalizer <- normalizers) {
   512→        strValue = normalizer(strValue)
   513→      }
   514→
   515→      Token(strValue, TokenType.String, metadata)
   516→    }
   517→  }
   518→}
